title: Keep one live worker session per slice instead of exec plus resume
body:
Outcome: a slice keeps one live worker session that loads the repository once and receives fix rounds as messages, replacing one-shot codex exec plus --resume; scope is path tiers checked on the diff, not an exhaustive --allow list. Measure worker tokens and minutes per slice against PR #167 (3 runs, 6+3+10 min, cumulative 546k tokens, which is over the 500k resume cap).
Source: operator 2026-11-02: delegating through a command is slowing delivery and the architecture needs improvement. May touch D18 routing; check against ADR 0014 before briefing.
